parameters.content: Clipping-engine ADAPTER, first implementation = OpenShorts (self-hosted). Verified against OpenShorts examples/n8n: POST {base}/api/process {url, acknowledged, webhook_url, webhook_secret}; completion arrives on a signed webhook (X-OpenShorts-Signature: sha256=HMAC(JSON.stringify(body))). No polling. A different engine = a new adapter workflow + clip_engines row.

parameters.query: SELECT j.job_id, j.job_type, j.entity_id, j.correlation_id, j.payload, j.attempt, ch.id AS channel_id, ch.name AS channel_name, ch.platforms, ch.clip_min_seconds, ch.clip_max_seconds, ch.rules, ch.timezone, ch.quality_threshold, n.name AS niche_name, n.keywords FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = NULLIF(j.payload->>'channel_id','')::uuid LEFT JOIN niches n ON n.id = ch.niche_id WHERE j.job_id = $1::uuid AND j.status = 'running'

SELECT s.source_id, s.normalized_url, s.status AS source_status, ca_rights_gate(s.source_id, $2::uuid) AS rights, ca_setting('allowed_source_domains','[]'::jsonb) AS allowed, (ca_setting('openshorts_base_url','"http://localhost:8000"'))#>>'{}' AS os_base, (ca_setting('n8n_webhook_base','"http://localhost:5678"'))#>>'{}' AS n8n_base FROM sources s WHERE s.source_id = $1::uuid

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ url: $json.url, acknowledged: true, webhook_url: $json.webhook_url, webhook_secret: $env.OPENSHORTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET }) }}

parameters.query: SELECT ca_job_fail(job_id, 'TRANSIENT', $2) FROM jobs WHERE external_job_id = $1 AND job_type = 'clipping' AND status = 'waiting'

meta.note: Credentials are NOT embedded. After import, open each node showing a credential warning and select your own credential (see SETUP.md).
